No new job, test dump, prediction analysis or bootstrap; interpolation runs are excluded because the declared P5 group is still incomplete. That nominal figure IS defensible as a count of sampler presentations up to and including the selected epoch, under four stated conventions. (1) Epoch indexing is 1-based and stopped_epoch is the number of completed epochs, confirmed three independent ways: the two locally retained per-epoch logs have exactly 67 and 18 epoch rows matching their stopped_epoch, the checkpoint filenames carry the selected epoch (best_e17, best_e3) matching best_epoch, and stopped_epoch equals best_epoch + patience in all six rows. (2) No image is dropped at the epoch boundary: in the pinned trainer (ultralytics 8.4.92, conda yoloV26, as recorded in code/train_student.py) the training loader defaults to drop_last False and uses ceil(n/batch) batches, so at batch 32 an epoch is 972 batches with a final batch of 11 images (expert) and 5,977 batches with a final batch of 26 (dense), and the product is exact rather than approximate. (3) Augmentation makes the figure a LOWER bound on distinct image draws, not a count of distinct images or pixels: mosaic is 1.0 with close_mosaic 10 and erasing 0.4, and because close_mosaic applies to the last 10 epochs of epochs_max (300 expert, 60 dense) while every run stopped far earlier, mosaic was active in every epoch of all six runs including the selected ones, so each presentation composes additional images. (4) Optimizer-update counts are UNRECOVERABLE from what is saved and are marked as such: nbs 64 against batch 32 gives accumulate = 2, during the 3 warm-up epochs accumulate is interpolated per iteration, and no update counter is written to the saved args or the per-epoch logs. Validation-check counts follow the once-per-epoch default (51/16/75/16/67/18) but are directly evidenced only for the two seed-3 runs whose per-epoch logs are retained locally. One finding that bears directly on the budget confound this record documents: the two groups did NOT share a training budget. The expert runs used epochs_max 300 with patience 50, the dense runs epochs_max 60 with patience 15. Every one of the six runs terminated by early stopping and none reached epochs_max, so stopped_epoch is a deterministic function of best_epoch plus a group-specific constant, and any cross-group comparison of samples_seen or stopped_epoch measures the stopping rule as much as the data.
